create_dataset_Kinetics: create a Kinetics video dataset instance with root path, frames per clip, and optional transforms
initialize_Kinetics_dataset: initialize a Kinetics dataset from torchvision with custom frame rate and audio channel parameters
retrieve_video_clip: retrieve a video clip, label, video index, and clip index from the Kinetics dataset by sample index
apply_transform_to_clip: apply a transform pipeline to a video clip before returning it from the Kinetics dataset
get_clip_location: get the video index and clip index location for a given sample index in the Kinetics dataset
